first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A purple lightning-patterned long sniper rifle held in first-person view, with a long black barrel and a large scope.

entities.name: first-person-view hand
entities.identification: The hand and partial forearm in the foreground wearing a fluorescent green, gray-white, and dark-gray paneled glove.

entities.name: group of white cargo crates covered with teal tarps
entities.identification: Three separate white cargo crates staggered front to back, with teal tarps covering their tops.

entities.name: light-brown cracked stone-paved area
entities.identification: Light-brown stone-paved ground with irregular light-colored joints and a partial red spray-painted arc.

entities.name: light-colored wooden barrier on the left
entities.identification: The light-beige vertical-board barrier in the near foreground on the image-left at the start, with horizontal reinforcing strips.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The red-and-black double-handled folding knife flipped by the first-person-view hand.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The dark-clad person lying horizontally close to the ground beside the distant steps on the image-left in this clip.

entities.name: low light-colored concrete wall
entities.identification: The thick off-white low wall extending behind the cargo-crate area, with a wide, flat coping.

entities.name: group of pale yellow-white flat-roofed buildings
entities.identification: The peripheral off-white and pale-yellow stucco buildings with flat roofs, small windows, colored window shutters, and old wall signs.

entities.name: pale-blue sky
entities.identification: The sky above the buildings, blue at the top and lighter near the distant rooftops.

entities.name: group of overhead power lines
entities.identification: Multiple thin dark cables above the buildings, some with sagging arcs.

entities.name: group of curved-top streetlights
entities.identification: A slender dark lamp pole with a curled upper end connected to a light-colored lamp head.

entities.name: green vegetation in the neighborhood
entities.identification: Green fan-shaped leaves and sparse branches and foliage visible behind the wall, plus a small amount of grass by the wall.

entities.name: group of light-blue cylindrical bagged containers
entities.identification: The upright light-blue-gray bag-like container on the image-left, with a circular top opening exposing a light-brown filling surface.

entities.name: light-colored strapped soft bundle
entities.identification: The low, bulging light-gray soft bundle in front of the container, with a brown top area and dark straps.

entities.name: group of pale-yellow woven baskets
entities.identification: The pale yellow-brown lidded woven basket in front of the low wall, with a rounded, bulging body.

entities.name: group of gray upright poles
entities.identification: The slender gray upright poles in the background, some topped with rectangular components or horizontal supports.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person whose dark head and shoulders are visible behind a low barrier block to the image-left of the leftmost cargo crate.
